reviews.review:
This game is dead and feels extremely hard to play solo because the AI teammembers are utter trash.
Devs should give all DLC free for this game to make up for how horrible this experience is....

DO NOT BUY THIS AT FULL PRICE!

UPDATE:
After having played the game some more, done Horde mode and finishing all the missions I want to update my review.

The game is fun to play but only after modding the game. I used mods to unlock more stuff, add better ai and rebalance the game and only then it felt playable. Sadly there are only 12 missions. I really hope that there will be more in the future. As of now I sadly still cannot recommend this game as it feels like an unfinished project. So buy at your own risk.

UPDATE: They finally fixed this!!

Game is pretty low budget. It stutters, it looks dated, sounds are pretty bad, voices are low quality, it stutters... Game is just pretty bad.

Geez there are a lot of positive reviews for this game. Well I am not one of them. First off to start this game is not worth 40 dollars if it was $15 Id say go for it. Other than that the game is just boring. The weapons sound effects are downright TERRIBLE. The aliens come at you single file from the walls and just makes it a shooting gallery type game instead. The missions are boring. The developers skipped out on all sort of things even lip syncing. Overall its just a mediocre game. Im not saying its "bad," but its just not fun. Especially for 40 dollars. 6/10 cheeks.

Good game overall if you are an Alien fan. You can customize your marine and select a few classes that play differently through the game. If you want to exterminate waves and waves of xenos, this is that game.
There is a good variety and choice of weapons and their mods so that it can adapt to your playstyle.
Maps and missions are good to play through.

It does get repetitive as the objective will allways be the same, keep moving and hold to the waves of xenos, there is no strategical value unless you play harder difficulties. There are not many "surprises" in this game, once you are done with the first 3 missions of the game you already know everything about it. Music is not memorable as other Alien games. Weapon Decals are very very bad implemented into the game (and yes I know you can enlarge or minimize them and adjust them), there are a few good ones. There is no lore, or true fun story going on in the game
There are no memorable or recognizable characters from the rest of the franchise. 
Would recommend it playing with friends for harder difficulties as it is very complicated with the AIs.
If you are not a big AvP fan you might want to pass on this game.
